answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit decay bond at the wharf to earn. A gale wears each bond down 5 credits every epoch. Each bond is a dune of 60; untended, it vanishes in twelve epochs, freezing the identity. Top-ups are public: one wallet feeding many bonds exposes a rented ring for slashing. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 5,000 per epoch: 160,000 over twenty epochs against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once and 5 per epoch from earnings.
